dataset_snapshot.note: The calibration files were regenerated during this review; these hashes are the snapshot measured here.

policy_snapshot.note: The policy was edited during the review; the current file is used for all cap/minimum/curriculum results.

config_training_gate.note: The shipped configs point at pilot-v2, not synthesis-calibration, and the license gate rejects unresolved-license records. This is a governance gate, not a tokenization failure.

tokenizer.name: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B
tokenizer.system_prompt_used: You are CyberLite, a defensive cybersecurity assistant. Prefer verifiable, safe guidance. Never claim to have executed commands or accessed systems.

manifest.limitations: Token counts are a length signal, not a quality measure. Truncation risk assumes the configured maximum sequence length and does not model the training collator or packing.

manifest_cross_check.note: manifest counts and this review agree within a few tokens; review includes the configured system prompt for chat and a terminating EOS.

records_with_unset_domain.note: source-derived records carry no metadata.domain; domain caps do not bind them

recommended_mixture.basis: 25,000 production records; proposed token shares solved against measured mean length per family to a ~7.28M-token epoch; 2 epochs.

epochs.reason: 0.8B model, ~7.4M tokens/epoch; >3 epochs risks memorising 25k records; configs currently set 1 epoch and mix.yaml targets 3.

sequence_policy.packing: greedy length-bucketed packing to 1024 with block-diagonal attention and position reset; fall back to length-sorted batching if packing is unavailable
sequence_policy.truncation: drop records >1024 tokens; never truncate the assistant span mid-answer
sequence_policy.note: min_supervised_tokens=1 currently admits a record that keeps only 7 of 201 answer tokens after truncation; raise it to at least 32 or switch to drop.

evaluation_checkpoints.selection: best family-macro validation loss; report per-family so small families are not hidden

recommended_mixture.split_recommendation: For calibration (500), use 5-fold grouped CV or 80/10/10 with per-family floors; for production (25k), use 90/5/5 -> 22.5k/1.25k/1.25k, stratified by family and kind, group-safe.

limitations: Token counts use the real Qwen3.5 tokenizer but do not model packing or per-batch padding.
Length is a signal, not a quality or difficulty measure; density and multi-hop flags are heuristics.
No model was trained; mixture recommendations are planning targets, not measured outcomes.
Calibration n=500 is small: family-level percentiles for families with <10 records are unstable.
Curriculum phase assignment is taken from mix.yaml; unlisted families are counted as uncovered.
Split adequacy analysis assumes evaluation accuracy is the comparison metric; other metrics have different power.
